SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed: There's a bed… Let's take a rest.
SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro:
I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.
I enjoy attending CONTESTS, you see.
SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle: I get so excited imagining what kinds of POKéMON I'll get to see in the next CONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!
SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle: Friends need not be human. For me, POKéMON are treasured friends!
SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro: Child… Did you knock on the door?
SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat: A loss is to be accepted without haste or panic.
SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle: To be never ruffled in any situation is the GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.
SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle: JED: It's the first time that our lovey- dovey power couldn't prevail! You must be an awesome TRAINER!
SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons: JED: You only have one POKéMON? Isn't that just too lonesome?
SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro: LEA: I feel a little silly, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle: LEA: I can't believe it! Our lovey-dovey power failed… You must be an awesome TRAINER!
SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons: LEA: I wanted to battle… But you don't even have two POKéMON…
SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro:
Ah, you've come just in time.
I'm bored, you see. You may entertain me.
SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire a yacht for me. A yacht for me and POKéMON!
SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER. Would you like to have tea? Or would you rather battle?
SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat: I see. You're the active sort.
SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle:
A world cruise on a luxury liner has its charms, I must say…
But, I will admit there is an appealing side to touring HOENN by ferry.
SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis:
Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious! Uh… You can have this! For free!
It… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from someone! I'd never do such a thing! It's clean! You can use it!
SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch: SNATCH steals the beneficial effects of certain moves before they can be used by a foe or ally.
